<thought>We need to determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups in the compound. The only way to get structural information is to request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which should show signals for methyl carbons (typically around 10‑30 ppm). By counting those signals we can infer the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
